backbone: official TSM ResNet50 RGB Kinetics400 uniform 8-frame
backbone_training: frozen feature extraction; no end-to-end fine-tuning in this pilot
label: observed real MS_rating > 2; values <= 2 are class 0
sampling: unique actual frames using actual timestamps; no padded/repeated frame substitution
cohort_policy: common real events with verified coverage for all three windows; no new scores or score carry-forward
raw_data_scope: modern data_file.csv sessions only; separate original rollercoaster_raw version is excluded
head: L2 LogisticRegression; C=0.1; equal session total weights then training-only binary class balancing
preprocessing: training-fold median imputation, constant removal and scaling; registered parameter log1p only
validation: Leave-One-Game-Out with test participant IDs removed from training
comparison: rerun every method on the same video-eligible event cohort; old 0.6819 is contextual only
interpretation: exploratory real self-report classification; not a calibrated personal risk probability and not a Unity-only pre-exposure tool
hardware: actual server GPU availability, driver compatibility, quota and policy must be checked on server
